bugs_found_by_tests.impact: a question nobody could answer was excluded from the score and nobody was told

property_tests: score never exceeds max_score (exhaustive over 27 answer combinations)
a correct answer never scores below a wrong one (5 penalty ratios)
the worst possible score is bounded by the total penalty
grading the same snapshot twice is identical (30 random exams)
question order does not change the total
the reported total always equals the sum of its items

acceptance_evidence.repeat_or_refresh_creates_no_second_atte: 3 idempotency tests, proven live (duplicate_submission=true, same id)
acceptance_evidence.past_score_unchanged_by_bank_or_policy_c: 2 adversarial tests, proven live (score 6.0 across a full bank rewrite)

student_flow: GET  /api/exam/exams/{id} -> 200, answer_key absent, choices are a list
POST /api/exam/exams/{id}/submit -> 200, score 2.0001 with 1 right 1 wrong under 1/3 negative marking
POST same answers again -> 200 duplicate_submission=true, same attempt id, same score
immutability_flow: rewrite both questions (new version, key=3, points=99)
re-read the old attempt -> 6.0, max 6.0, unchanged
a new student submitting to the same exam -> 6.0 (pinned v1)
